cues.text: How many people came in, when and through which door, compared with last week and with tenant sales.
Footfall counts the visitors at every entrance, live from the door counters.
Visitors so far today, the busiest hour and the cars, each compared with the same day last week at this hour.
The solid line is today; the dashed line is the same day last week.
Change the period: yesterday, the last 7 days or the last 30 days.
By entrance shows which doors bring people in. It helps you place promotions and guards.
Visitors and tenant sales puts the crowd next to what the stores sold, so you see how much each visitor spends.
Export the figures to a spreadsheet whenever you need them.
If a counter was offline, import its counts from a file here.
And Entrances and counters is where the doors and their counters are set up.
